name: Audio Manager Lite
headline: Switch speakers or headphones with one key.
description:
Audio Manager Lite gives Stream Deck one simple, useful Windows audio job: switch your Default Output device with a key.

Create separate keys for speakers, headphones, a monitor, a USB DAC, or another playback device. Each key remembers its target and shows the device directly on Stream Deck.

Lite is intentionally output-only. It does not include Audio Profiles, input switching, Communications routing, profile cycling/status, microphone controls, or Stream Deck+ profile volume.

Need to switch your entire setup at once? Audio Manager Pro adds complete Audio Profiles for output + input + Communications roles, plus capture/apply/cycle/status, saved volume and mute restore, direct input controls, and Stream Deck+ profile volume.

Starter layouts are included for Standard/MK.2, XL, Stream Deck+, and Neo.

Runs locally on Windows. Requires Windows 10+ and Stream Deck 7.3+.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: Initial release. Free Windows Default Output switching with bundled Stream Deck layouts and Audio Manager Pro upgrade path.
